responseText:
So, I've been all up and down the old waterways, hunting Minotaur. Those beasts are our ancient enemy you know. My grandfather told me such fireside stories about them! Who could have known that I'd grow up to stalk them in the wild - for real?

They despoil our great works, you know. Legend has it they eat babies.
